correctness.rationale: Necessary direction: inclusion-antichain of host rows forces strictly opposite nestings of red/blue Ferrers row sets; an allowed edge between two missing positions contradicts one chain. Sufficiency: complement column interval gives red initial and blue terminal segments, both Ferrers and disjoint. On K_n,n minus a Hamiltonian 2n-cycle the n missing two-row column sets cannot all be consecutive in a linear order with only n-1 adjacent pairs; triangular red/blue Ferrers parts plus one star attain 3. Induced matching = 2 for n>=4 because three would force triangle in C_n; n=3 matching exception. Independent direct enumeration checks 12+384+600 antichain instances, constructions n=3..29 and induced matching n=3..6. These finite checks corroborate, not replace, universal proof.
